# Jay Pokale

> Engineer & graduate researcher at IIT Hyderabad. Top 1% competitive programmer
> worldwide. Founder of Dare2Solve, a 20,000-strong mathematics community.
> Site: https://jaypokale.me · Contact: jay.pokale.35@gmail.com

## Facts

- LeetCode: Guardian badge (top 1% of ~880,000 contest participants), peak
  contest rating 2285, 1,637 problems solved (341 Hard) —
  https://leetcode.com/u/jaypokale
- Codeforces: Expert (rating 1799 as of September 2026), handle rdx_panther —
  https://codeforces.com/profile/rdx_panther
- Research (IIT Hyderabad, three theses in progress):
  1. "Corroboration Is All You Can Certify" — certified defenses against
     structural poisoning of GraphRAG (witness packing).
  2. "Cache Me If You Can" — the locality–integrity law for semantic caches,
     and a containment gate that escapes it.
  3. "Some Memories Take Time" — an allocation law for multi-timescale
     continual learning, set by the data's Zipf spectrum.
- Open source:
  - Chisle — token-efficiency toolkit for AI coding agents (Claude Code,
    Cursor, Codex, Gemini and more); 500+ GitHub stars, zero dependencies,
    publishes the benchmarks it loses. https://chisle.jaypokale.me ·
    https://github.com/JayPokale/Chisle
  - typed-numarray — npm package for dynamic typed arrays in JavaScript.
    https://www.npmjs.com/package/typed-numarray
  - competitive — a documented DSA library for competitive programming in
    JavaScript. https://github.com/JayPokale/competitive
  - Upstream: merged PRs to ballerina-platform/ballerina-dev-website.
- Personal projects: GST Legal RAG (production retrieval over Indian GST law,
  abstains rather than fabricate citations), a case-law knowledge graph,
  Forge (durable task orchestration), Office Management (web + mobile).
- Community: founder of Dare2Solve (20k+ members), mathematics problem-solving —
  http://dare2solve.jaypokale.me
- Off the keyboard: powerlifter.
- Profiles: https://github.com/JayPokale · https://www.linkedin.com/in/JayPokale
